need from front to back through one convenient platform.

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]

to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

## Celerion’s commitment to swift, exceptional research through translational medicine.

Every day, we use our experience, agility, and innovative research strategies to help get your drug
to market faster—so your treatments can touch the lives of family, friends, and people in need
around the world.

## What We Do

Celerion accelerates drug development through world-class early-phase clinical research and advanced
bioanalysis services. We conduct early-phase clinical studies and provide bioanalytical support
across all stages of development, from preclinical through late-stage clinical. Our clinical and
bioanalytical teams draw on deep global expertise to deliver fast, reliable data and insights that
support confident decision-making.

[Learn More][139]

## Early Phase Clinical Services

### Delivering Early Phase Confidence Through Expertise and Experience

With 50+ years of experience and more than 650 beds worldwide, we offer the largest global network
of early phase operations in the industry. Find out how our expertise, facilities, and full range of
clinical research services prepare us to address the unique needs of your product’s early phase
development.

### July is Vacation Time and UV Safety Month

It’s summertime - that means fun, sun, and vacations! Just because you are going through cancer
treatment doesn’t mean you can’t take a vacation. Watch the [Cancer Goes to the Beach][101] webinar
to get tips and resources to plan a safe and stress-free getaway. Wondering about [vacation while on
radiation treatment][102]? July is also UV Safety Month – learn all you need to know to [stay sun
safe][103] this summer.

# Simoncini Cancer Therapy

Treat cancer as a fungus
[dr tullio simoncini]

#### Dr. Simoncini Cancer Therapy

Dr. Tullio Simoncini, – oncologist from Rome, Italy – has pioneered sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO3)
therapy as a means to treat cancer. The fundamental theory behind this treatment lies in the fact
that, despite a number of variable factors, the formation and spreading of tumors is simply the
result of the presence of a fungus.

[more][7]
[simoncini sodium bicarbonate iv]

#### Sodium Bicarbonate

Sodium bicarbonate, unlike other anti-fungal remedies to which the fungus can become immune, is
extremely diffusible and retains its ability to penetrate the tumor, due to the speed at which the
sodium bicarbonate disintegrates the tumor. This speed makes fungi’s adaptability impossible,
rendering it defenseless.

[more][8]

## General information

[dr tulklio simoncini rome italy]

#### About Dr. Simoncini

Tullio Simoncini is a roman doctor specialising in oncology, diabetology and in metabolic disorders.
He has a strong opposition to any type of intellectual conformity, which is often based on
suppositions without foundation or worse, on lies and falsities.

[sodium bicarbonate IV solution]

#### Sodium bicarbonate

The fundamental reason and the motives that suggest a therapy with sodium bicarbonate against
tumours is that, although with the concurrence of a myriad of variable concausal factors – the
development and the local and remote proliferation of these tumours has a cause that is exclusively
fungin.

[candida albicans]

#### Candida Albicans

Candida in cancer patients is usually interpreted as a consequence of the weakening and of the
exhaustion of the organism because of neoplastic lesions. But candida is not a post hoc but an ante
hoc cause.

[treatment-protocols]

#### Treatment protocols

Dr. Simoncini’s methods have cured people for over 25 years. Many of his patients recovered
completely from cancer, even in cases where official oncology had given up.
The best way to try to eliminate a tumour is to bring it into contact with sodium bicarbonate, as
closely as possible.

## Interviews with Dr. Simoncini

[dr tulklio simoncini rome italy]

#### An introduction to the therapy

In this video interview Dr. Simoncini tells about his findings regarding the therapy utilizing
sodium bicarbonate.

[sodium bicarbonate IV solution]

#### The first video, back in 2007

The first interview with Tullio Simoncini in English goes back to 2007. In this video you will see
more about treatments, patients en examples of the therapy.

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

## Celerion’s commitment to swift, exceptional research through translational medicine.

Every day, we use our experience, agility, and innovative research strategies to help get your drug
to market faster—so your treatments can touch the lives of family, friends, and people in need
around the world.

## What We Do

Celerion accelerates drug development through world-class early-phase clinical research and advanced
bioanalysis services. We conduct early-phase clinical studies and provide bioanalytical support
across all stages of development, from preclinical through late-stage clinical. Our clinical and
bioanalytical teams draw on deep global expertise to deliver fast, reliable data and insights that
support confident decision-making.

[Learn More][139]

With 50+ years of experience and more than 650 beds worldwide, we offer the largest global network
of early phase operations in the industry. Find out how our expertise, facilities, and full range of
clinical research services prepare us to address the unique needs of your product’s early phase
development.

Global Cancer Treatment & Trial Access

# Advanced Cancer *Treatment*

"CancerFax connects patients with complex, advanced, or relapsed cancers to expert second opinions,
cell and gene therapies, and clinical trials across China, India, Israel, Singapore, and the USA
through honest, clinically literate, patient-first navigation."

[Start your case review][27][Read patient stories][28]
Andreea Milca - Romania
Breast & Thyroid Cancer - 18 months in remission

Hi, I see you found us. If you're scared, I was too. A year ago I was Stage IV and had no options at
home. CancerFax found me a trial 4,000 miles away. You're not alone in this. Connect with me :-).

Patient Pathways

## How Can We Help You Today?

Choose where you are in your cancer journey and we'll guide you to the right resources and next
steps.

[

### Explore Advanced Treatments

CAR-T, TIL therapy, gene therapy, immunotherapy and more — understand what's available for your
diagnosis.

][29][

### Find Cancer-Specific Options

Search treatment and trial options tailored to your specific cancer type, stage, and molecular
profile.

][30][

### Get a Second Opinion

Access specialist review of your diagnosis, imaging, pathology, and current treatment plan from
expert oncologists.

][31][

### Search Clinical Trials

Explore investigational therapies and clinical trial opportunities that may be appropriate for your
condition.

][32][

### Compare Hospitals & Doctors

Understand your options across leading cancer centres, specialist expertise, and international
treatment destinations.

][33][

### Plan Treatment Abroad

End-to-end support for international care: visa guidance, medical coordination, travel assistance,
and more.

][34]
Advanced Cancer Treatment Navigation

## What does CancerFax do?

"Advanced cancer treatment guidance, clinical trial matching, and care coordination are three
pillars that take cancer patients from uncertainty to clarity."

### Comprehensive Medical Record Review

We carefully review your pathology reports, imaging scans, molecular test results, previous
treatments, and current clinical condition to understand your case as a whole. This comprehensive
assessment provides the foundation for identifying suitable treatment options and determining the
most appropriate next steps.

### Expert Second Opinion

We connect your case with experienced oncologists and multidisciplinary specialists for an
independent medical opinion. The second-opinion process can help confirm the diagnosis, review the
current treatment plan, identify overlooked options, and provide greater confidence before an
important treatment decision is made.

### Personalized Treatment Guidance

We help you understand which advanced treatment options may be relevant to your diagnosis, disease
stage, previous treatments, and molecular markers. These may include CAR T-cell therapy, TIL
therapy, gene therapy, immunotherapy, targeted therapy, proton therapy, and other emerging
treatments. We translate complex medical information into clear and actionable guidance.

### Specialist and Hospital Navigation

CancerFax helps match patients with appropriate specialists, hospitals, and cancer centers based on
their specific medical needs. We evaluate clinical expertise, treatment availability, institutional
capabilities, expected timelines, and other practical considerations so patients can make informed
decisions about where to seek treatment.

### Clinical Trial Matching and Access

We identify relevant clinical trials for patients with advanced, relapsed, rare, or
difficult-to-treat cancers, and we have particular expertise in accessing trials in China, India, [[CancerFax logo][CancerFax logo]][1]

## What does CancerFax do?

"Advanced cancer treatment guidance, clinical trial matching, and care coordination are three
pillars that take cancer patients from uncertainty to clarity."

### Comprehensive Medical Record Review

We carefully review your pathology reports, imaging scans, molecular test results, previous
treatments, and current clinical condition to understand your case as a whole. This comprehensive
assessment provides the foundation for identifying suitable treatment options and determining the
most appropriate next steps.

### Expert Second Opinion

We connect your case with experienced oncologists and multidisciplinary specialists for an
independent medical opinion. The second-opinion process can help confirm the diagnosis, review the
current treatment plan, identify overlooked options, and provide greater confidence before an
important treatment decision is made.

### Personalized Treatment Guidance

We help you understand which advanced treatment options may be relevant to your diagnosis, disease
stage, previous treatments, and molecular markers. These may include CAR T-cell therapy, TIL
therapy, gene therapy, immunotherapy, targeted therapy, proton therapy, and other emerging
treatments. We translate complex medical information into clear and actionable guidance.

### Specialist and Hospital Navigation

CancerFax helps match patients with appropriate specialists, hospitals, and cancer centers based on
their specific medical needs. We evaluate clinical expertise, treatment availability, institutional
capabilities, expected timelines, and other practical considerations so patients can make informed
decisions about where to seek treatment.

### Clinical Trial Matching and Access

We identify relevant clinical trials for patients with advanced, relapsed, rare, or
difficult-to-treat cancers, and we have particular expertise in accessing trials in China, India,
and the USA. Our team conducts an initial eligibility review, communicates with trial centers, and
guides patients through screening, documentation, and enrollment.

### End-to-End Care Coordination

From preparing medical documents and communicating with hospitals to appointment scheduling, visa
assistance, travel planning, admission support, and continuity of care, CancerFax coordinates the
complete treatment journey. This allows patients and their families to focus on treatment while we
manage the clinical and logistical details.

## Cancer Types We

## Specialize In

Our partner hospitals are leaders in treating a wide spectrum of malignancies, with specialist tumor
boards dedicated to each type.

Lung Cancer

EGFR/ALK-targeted therapies, immunotherapy combinations, and minimally invasive surgery. China leads
the world in lung cancer research volume.

Hematologic Malignancies

CAR-T cell therapy for leukemia and lymphoma, with China's leading centers performing more CAR-T
procedures than anywhere else globally.

Breast, Prostate & Gynecologic

Comprehensive multidisciplinary management including hormone therapy, targeted agents, and
fertility-sparing surgical techniques.

Brain & CNS Tumors

Advanced neurosurgical techniques including awake craniotomy, Gamma Knife radiosurgery, and emerging
immunotherapeutic approaches.

Liver & Gastrointestinal Cancer

Hepatocellular carcinoma, colorectal, and gastric cancers — areas of particular Chinese oncology
expertise given local disease prevalence and research investment.

## Why Our Patients Choose Integrative Oncology

China's unique medical heritage means cancer patients receive something rare: the full power of
modern oncology, enhanced by millennia of botanical and lifestyle medicine refined specifically to
support cancer care.

Our partner hospitals offer dedicated integrative oncology programs where TCM practitioners work
alongside medical oncologists — not as an alternative, but as evidence-based supportive care.

 Reduced chemotherapy side effects

 Improved immune function during treatment

 Enhanced quality of life & sleep

 Evidence-based TCM protocols

## Building the Future of Cancer Care

Our patient-centered approach is grounded in a singular focus — cancer care. That focus has driven
us throughout our history, and it has resulted in plans for a new dedicated inpatient cancer
hospital, and a transformative clinical collaboration.

[ Our Vision for Cancer Care ][133]

## Discover the Dana-Farber Difference

[physician-and-patient-stethoscope-600x368.webp]
[

Exceptional Clinical Care

][134]

At Dana-Farber, world-renowned specialists provide personalized cancer care informed by the latest
advances in treatment. From diagnosis through survivorship, we partner with patients and families to
deliver exceptional care and support every step of the way.

[researcher-writing-on-glass556x381.jpg]
[

Groundbreaking Research

][135]

Dana-Farber Cancer Institute remains true to Dr. Sidney Farber's vision of a cancer center that is
as dedicated to discoveries in cancer research as it is to delivering compassionate,
patient-centered care. Discoveries made by Dana-Farber researchers today become tomorrow’s
breakthrough treatments.

# Powerful
# & Precise Radiation.

Cancer Treatment That Prioritizes
Your Quality of Life

## How Proton Therapy Works

Proton therapy is an extremely precise form of radiation treatment.

It uses positively charged particles to deliver radiation that matches the size, shape, and depth of
a tumor down to the millimeter. Unlike traditional radiation, protons stop at the tumor, reducing
exposure to surrounding healthy tissue. This may lower the risk of side effects and help patients
return to life sooner.

[ Learn More ][38]

## How Proton Therapy Works

Proton therapy is an extremely precise form of radiation treatment.

It uses positively charged particles to deliver radiation that matches the size, shape, and depth of
a tumor down to the millimeter. Unlike traditional radiation, protons stop at the tumor, reducing
exposure to surrounding healthy tissue. This may lower the risk of side effects and help patients
return to life sooner.

## About

### ESMO Open

[[Cover Image - ESMO Open, Volume 11, Issue 7]][78]

*ESMO Open* is the European Society for Medical Oncology's online-only, peer-reviewed open access
journal, dedicated to publishing high-quality medical research and educational content from all
disciplines of oncology, with a focus on innovative clinical and translational cancer research. The
Journal aims to maximize industry networks to curate and disseminate preclinical or translational
data. We hope to bridge the gap between basic research and clinical applications, facilitating the
translation of groundbreaking discoveries into tangible advancements in cancer care. Our platform
will serve as a catalyst for innovation, nurturing the dialogue between academia, industry, and
clinical practice.

### ESMO

[ESMO  Opens in new window][79]   is the European Society for Medical Oncology. Representing over
50,000 members globally, ESMO is a reference for oncology education and information.

Founded in 1975, ESMO has European roots with a global reach. Home for all oncology stakeholders,
ESMO connects professionals with diverse expertise and experience. Its education and information
resources support an integrated multi-professional approach to cancer care, from a medical oncology
perspective.

ESMO seeks to erase boundaries in cancer care, whether between countries or specialities, and pursue
its mission

## What is **Proton Therapy**?

an effective cancer treatment alternative

Less risk. Higher quality of life during treatment.

Proton therapy for cancer is an advanced form of radiation that uses protons, rather than X-rays.
Protons can be precisely controlled, allowing our physicians to closely target your tumor and
deliver powerful doses of radiation with:
* Less damage to healthy tissue
* Fewer side effects
* Low risk of secondary cancers
* Better quality of life during and after treatment

## Non-Toxic Therapies That Target Cancer Cells

Patient-Centered Integrative & Alternative Cancer Treatment Center

Take the first step toward integrative cancer care. Contact Hope4Cancer to schedule a complimentary
consultation and receive a personalized treatment plan tailored to individual diagnosis and goals.

Play Video [Dr. Tony Jimenez speaking with a doctor at Hope4Cancer] Your browser does not support
the video tag.

Hope4Cancer Treatment Centers provide personalized, non-toxic alternative cancer treatment at two
world-class facilities in Cancun and Playas de Tijuana, Mexico. Since 2000, the board-certified
medical team led by founder Antonio Jimenez, M.D., N.D., has treated thousands of patients from over
100 countries, offering more integrative cancer therapies under one roof than any other center in
the world.

Integrative Cancer Treatment Rooted in the 7 Key Principles

Every treatment program at Hope4Cancer follows the 7 Key Principles of Cancer Therapy, a
comprehensive clinical framework that addresses cancer from multiple angles simultaneously. Rather
than focusing solely on the tumor, this approach treats the whole person, targeting cancer cells
with non-toxic therapies while simultaneously restoring immune function, optimizing nutrition,
supporting detoxification, rebalancing the microbiome, providing oxygenation therapy, and addressing
emotional and spiritual well-being.

Non-Toxic Therapies That Target Cancer Cells

The Hope4Cancer protocol includes Sono-Photo Dynamic Therapy (SPDT), Photo Dynamic Therapy Plus
using advanced laser technology, bio-immunotherapy, hyperthermia, pulsed electromagnetic field
therapy (PEMF), ozone therapy, IV nutrient infusions, and many additional modalities. Each therapy
is selected for its ability to selectively target malignant cells while leaving healthy tissue
unharmed, avoiding the debilitating side effects commonly associated with conventional chemotherapy
and radiation.

Immune System Restoration and Support

The proprietary Sunivera Bio-Immunotherapy Protocol combines a macrophage activating factor (MAF)
with synergistic nutraceuticals to modulate both innate and adaptive immune responses. This
protocol, developed from 25 years of research at leading institutions, helps restore the immune
system's natural cancer-fighting capabilities, which are often compromised by the disease itself or
by prior conventional treatments.

World-Class Cancer Treatment Centers

Hope4Cancer operates two strategically located treatment centers on the Pacific and Caribbean coasts
of Mexico. Both facilities provide access to cutting-edge therapies and technologies in
healing-focused environments.

# Pioneering a Transformational Approach to Treating Cancer

Iovance Biotherapeutics is pioneering a transformational approach to treating cancer by harnessing
the ability of the human immune system to recognize and attack diverse cancer cells in each patient.

[About Iovance Biotherapeutics][41]

## TIL therapy

Tumor infiltrating lymphocytes (TIL) are naturally occurring immune cells that fight cancer. TIL are
on constant surveillance to recognize, attack and kill cancer cells. When cancer invades and
prevails, the TIL are unable to perform their intended function. Investigational TIL therapies are
designed to reinvigorate a patient’s TIL to fight cancer. A patient’s naturally occurring TIL are
collected and grown outside the body so they can be administered back to the patient as a one-time
treatment. Once inside the body, **Iovance TIL therapy deploys billions of personalized,
patient-specific TIL to recognize and target diverse cancer cells.**

TIL monotherapy and TIL combination therapies are being investigated in clinical studies in multiple
advanced solid tumor cancers.

 

[Learn more about TIL therapy][42]

[View our scientific publications & presentations][43]

## Now Enrolling

[ Advanced Front-line Melanoma (TILVANCE-301) ][44] [ Advanced Second-line NSCLC (IOV-LUN-202) ][45]
[ Advanced Endometrial Cancer (IOV-END-201) ][46]

## Latest news

[ View All News Releases ][47]

## Clinical platforms

Our T-cell-based immunotherapy technology platforms are potentially applicable to many solid tumor
types. Each platform is focused on leveraging patient-specific cells to recognize and attack diverse
cancer cells that are unique to each patient. Unlike targeted cell therapies that act on shared
antigen targets common to certain tumors, our polyclonal T cells are personalized therapies designed
to target a variety of neoantigens (new proteins generated by tumor mutations) that are unique to
the patient or tumor.

We are currently investigating TIL therapy in clinical trials in multiple advanced solid tumor
cancers. We are also advancing genetically modified TIL therapies as a next-generation approach for
solid tumor cancers.

[View our clinical pipeline][48]

## Iovance Cell Therapy Center (*i*CTC)

Our TIL therapy is manufactured at our state-of-the-art, 136,000–square-foot Cell Therapy Center,
located in Philadelphia, PA, using proprietary good manufacturing practices (GMP).

[Learn more about the *i*CTC][49]

  graduate medical education programs in the country.

  environment.
  
  The Center is the largest program of its kind embedded within a healthcare system in the U.S.

It’s summertime - that means fun, sun, and vacations! Just because you are going through cancer
treatment doesn’t mean you can’t take a vacation. Watch the [Cancer Goes to the Beach][101] webinar
to get tips and resources to plan a safe and stress-free getaway. Wondering about [vacation while on
radiation treatment][102]? July is also UV Safety Month – learn all you need to know to [stay sun
safe][103] this summer.

# Proton beam therapy protects what matters. *Understand the difference.*

[ Learn more ][74]

At Proton International London, the UK’s only private proton beam therapy service, we deliver
precise, protective, and powerful cancer treatment.

## What is proton beam therapy?

Proton beam therapy is an advanced type of radiotherapy that uses highly charged particles to
deliver radiation to cancer cells, to stop them growing and spreading.

[Learn more][75]

## What are the benefits?

Proton beam therapy targets tumours with greater precision than traditional radiotherapy, reducing
the risk of short and long-term side effects.

[Read about the benefits][76]

## What can I expect?

Proton beam therapy treatment sessions usually take around an hour, five days a week, for several
weeks. It is delivered via a specialist proton beam machine from outside the body and is painless.

[What to expect][77]

## Who is it for?

Proton beam therapy is suitable for treating cancer where precision is vital to avoid damage to
healthy cells, such as in children and adults with brain, spinal, and prostate cancer (among
others).

[Am I suitable for proton beam therapy?][78]

## Welcome to the UK’s only private proton beam therapy centre

At Proton International London, we offer an advanced form of radiotherapy known as proton beam
therapy (PBT).

Treatment is available to private patients from the UK and worldwide at our treatment centre in the
esteemed University College Hospital in London, in partnership with University College London
Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust (UCLH).

If you are here, then perhaps you are researching cancer treatment for yourself or a loved one.
Firstly, we understand how overwhelming this can feel, and we’re here to offer clarity and
reassurance. Our website is designed to give you all of the information you need about proton beam
therapy to help you make informed decisions and take your next step with confidence.

effects and, in turn, improve quality of life. This is particularly helpful in treating children,

effects.

## FAQs

**How can social networking benefit physicians?**

As a physician, being up-to-date on today’s medical news is essential; but remaining on the
cutting-edge of the medical world is not easy. A social network for doctors like Sermo can help
empower physicians across [medical specialties][46] to achieve their personal and professional
goals, while having fun and making meaningful connections with others.

Sermo is the only dedicated social network for doctors in the world—bringing together more than
1,000,000 triple-verified physicians, who are looking for and sharing the latest medical insights.
By joining Sermo, you can improve your medical practice and grow your professional network.

Sermo gives you access to the latest medical news so you can read, collaborate, and discuss with
your fellow professionals. The easy-to-use platform provides access to exclusive content, while
helping you keep a pulse on the latest happenings in the medical world.

The popularity of social media by physicians had been steadily and consistently growing; but in
2020—as COVID-19 completely changed the way the world communicated—the number of physicians engaging
in social media grew exponentially. Sermo experienced an 83% increase in global unique logins on its
platform alone—and a 24% increase in time spent on the site.

When physicians were asked to compare physician-only social platforms against general social media,
they said physician-only platforms offered more credibility, security, privacy, value of
information, and allowed a better connectivity with peers.

*“Sermo is an excellent tool for connecting colleagues and often helps us share our experiences and
clarify diagnostic and therapeutic doubts.”* —Sermo Member, Orthopedic Surgeon

1. Staying up to date on medical news.
2. Connecting with peers.
3. Sharing knowledge.

# Simoncini Cancer Therapy

Treat cancer as a fungus
[dr tullio simoncini]

#### Dr. Simoncini Cancer Therapy

Dr. Tullio Simoncini, – oncologist from Rome, Italy – has pioneered sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO3)
therapy as a means to treat cancer. The fundamental theory behind this treatment lies in the fact
that, despite a number of variable factors, the formation and spreading of tumors is simply the
result of the presence of a fungus.

[more][7]
[simoncini sodium bicarbonate iv]

#### Sodium Bicarbonate

Sodium bicarbonate, unlike other anti-fungal remedies to which the fungus can become immune, is
extremely diffusible and retains its ability to penetrate the tumor, due to the speed at which the
sodium bicarbonate disintegrates the tumor. This speed makes fungi’s adaptability impossible,
rendering it defenseless.

[more][8]

## General information

[dr tulklio simoncini rome italy]

#### About Dr. Simoncini

Tullio Simoncini is a roman doctor specialising in oncology, diabetology and in metabolic disorders.
He has a strong opposition to any type of intellectual conformity, which is often based on
suppositions without foundation or worse, on lies and falsities.

[sodium bicarbonate IV solution]

#### Sodium bicarbonate

The fundamental reason and the motives that suggest a therapy with sodium bicarbonate against
tumours is that, although with the concurrence of a myriad of variable concausal factors – the
development and the local and remote proliferation of these tumours has a cause that is exclusively
fungin.

[candida albicans]

#### Candida Albicans

Candida in cancer patients is usually interpreted as a consequence of the weakening and of the
exhaustion of the organism because of neoplastic lesions. But candida is not a post hoc but an ante
hoc cause.

[treatment-protocols]

#### Treatment protocols

Dr. Simoncini’s methods have cured people for over 25 years. Many of his patients recovered
completely from cancer, even in cases where official oncology had given up.
The best way to try to eliminate a tumour is to bring it into contact with sodium bicarbonate, as
closely as possible.

At Texas Oncology, we're committed to making your cancer care experience as supportive and
empowering as possible.


Our team of compassionate, highly trained oncologists provides comprehensive treatment options
tailored to your individual needs. Whether you're undergoing chemotherapy, radiation, or other
therapies, we’re here to guide you with expertise, respect, and care — every step of the way.

‌

[[Texas Oncology banner image featuring a smiling older male patient holding a cane while a
healthcare provider in blue scrubs places a reassuring hand on his shoulder, conveying compassionate
patient care, with a blue overlay on the left side of the image]][11]
[About Texas Oncology][12]

Texas Oncology’s mission is to provide evidence-based and high-quality care to each patient we
serve, while advancing cancer care for tomorrow.

‌

[[Texas Oncology banner image featuring a smiling young female cancer patient seated across from her
physician at a consultation table, with a clipboard nearby, conveying compassionate and personalized
cancer care, with a blue overlay on the left side of the image]][13]
[Cancer Care][14]

Texas Oncology helps patients navigate their cancer journeys with a highly-skilled care team
featuring physicians, advanced practice providers, pharmacists, and social workers.

‌

[[Texas Oncology banner image featuring a focused female researcher in a white lab coat, safety
goggles, and stethoscope working in a laboratory setting, with a deep blue overlay on the left side
of the image]][15]
[Clinical Trials][16]

Texas Oncology is a leader in groundbreaking cancer research and clinical trials in Texas, paving
the way for new breakthroughs in cancer care.

## Our Specialty Programs

Specialty

### [Medical Oncology][17]

Our medical oncology team specializes in diagnosis, personalized treatment planning, and coordinated
care to support you every step of the way.
Specialty

### [Radiation Oncology][18]

Targeted radiation therapy tailored to your goals for effective, precise cancer care.
Specialty

### [Hematology][19]

Comprehensive care for blood cancers and disorders—anemia, leukemia, and clotting—personalized
treatment close to home.
Specialty

### [Breast Care][20]

Texas Breast Specialists is a group of physicians dedicated to diagnosing and treating diseases and
disorders of the breast – both cancerous and benign.
Specialty

### [Colorectal Care][21]

The surgeons of Texas Colon & Rectal Specialists offer advanced screening, diagnosis, and treatment
for colon and rectal conditions, improving health and quality of life.
Specialty

### [Urology][22]

The physicians of Texas Urology Specialists offer compassionate and comprehensive urology care and
advanced treatments for a wide range of urologic conditions.
Specialty

### [Surgical Oncology][23]

Texas Oncology Surgical Specialists offers comprehensive cancer surgery—biopsies, tumor removal, and
minimally invasive options from skilled surgical oncologists.
Specialty

### [Gynecologic Oncology][24]

Compassionate, advanced surgery and care for ovarian, uterine, cervical, and vulvar cancers.
Specialty

### [Proton Therapy][25]

Targeted proton therapy delivers powerful cancer treatment with fewer side effects—close to home at
Texas Oncology.
[Exterior of a Texas Oncology clinic location at 9750 Hillwood Parkway, featuring a modern building
with large glass windows, wood panel accents, and the Texas Oncology logo displayed prominently on
the stone facade, surrounded by native ornamental grasses under a partly cloudy sky]
We make it as easy as possible to access the care you need. With more than 250 locations, you are
likely to find a provider near where you live and work.

### A Mother and Son’s Journey to Overcoming Hodgkin’s Lymphoma

Michelle Prescott, a mother of five based in Conroe, Texas, wasn’t one to visit the doctor for minor
health issues, but one afternoon in December 2019, something was off.

Colon Cancer

### How Clinical Trials Can Make a Difference: A Colon Cancer Patient’s Story

After a stage IV colon cancer diagnosis, Aline found hope through Texas Oncology and a clinical
trial that helped her regain strength and fight back.

[Read More
][30]

Head and Neck Cancer

### Warb’s Journey with Nasopharyngeal Cancer

After an EBV-linked cancer diagnosis, Warb turned adversity into action, improving air quality for
fellow patients while fighting his own battle.

# Dependable medical supply support for Indian health organizations.

Tribal Innovations is a Native-owned medical-supply distributor helping Indian Health Service
facilities, tribal healthcare programs, and urban Indian health organizations access the products
they need with responsive, relationship-first service.

[Request a quote][8][View product categories][9]

Why Tribal Innovations

## Native ownership, workflow capability, and fulfillment depth — together

Tribal Innovations combines Native-owned positioning with the operational capability and supply
depth to actually deliver — making us a more credible partner for Indian health organizations.

### Native-owned and procurement-aligned

Built to serve Indian Health Service facilities, tribally operated healthcare programs, and urban
Indian health organizations through a Native-owned business model.

### Workflow capability that supports execution

Tribal’s model is designed to help manage invoicing, account coordination, and the practical steps
required to move orders forward.

### Supply depth through a national partner

The company’s operating model combines community alignment with broader fulfillment infrastructure,
helping reduce the gap between access and reliable delivery.

Who We Serve

## Supporting the organizations at the heart of Indian health procurement

### Indian Health Service facilities

Reliable medical-supply support for Indian health operations.

### Tribally operated healthcare programs

Responsive service built for the way tribal healthcare programs work.

### Urban Indian health organizations

Dependable product access through a Native-owned partner.

[Cardinal Health — authorized distributor partner of Tribal Innovations]

Supply Partnership

## Authorized distributor partner of Cardinal Health

A recurring challenge in this market is vendors who win contracts but lack the supply depth to
fulfill reliably. Tribal Innovations addresses this directly: as an authorized Cardinal Health
distributor, customers get access to Cardinal's full product catalog and fulfillment infrastructure
— through a Native-owned partner.

Access to Cardinal Health's full medical-supply catalog

Reliable fulfillment through an established national supply network

Native-owned positioning without sacrificing product depth or reliability

What We Bring

## Built to deliver, not just to win the contract

Indian health procurement rewards vendors who show up reliably over time. Tribal Innovations is
built around the capabilities that make that possible.

Authorized Cardinal Health distributor — access to a broad national catalog, not a thin sourcing
list.

Native-owned positioning aligned with Indian health procurement pathways and preference programs.

Invoicing and billing support designed for Indian health settings, including coordination with
government payment workflows.

Direct, responsive account management — a real relationship, not a ticketing system.

A fulfillment model built for reliability, so the order that gets placed is the order that arrives.

Family Leadership

## Rooted in Jemez Pueblo, built for the long term

Tribal Innovations is led by a family with deep community roots in Jemez Pueblo and a clear
commitment to service, trust, and long-term follow-through.

[Meet the leadership team][10]
[Allen Gachupin]

### Allen Gachupin

President

Allen Gachupin founded Tribal Innovations and serves as President, leading the company with a
philosophy grounded in service, character, and accountability. A proud Jemez Pueblo tribal member
and U.S. Army veteran, he has dedicated his career to community leadership and building lasting
relationships.

[Kai Gachupin]

### Kai Gachupin

CEO

Kai Gachupin serves as CEO of Tribal Innovations, bringing more than two decades of experience
leading Native-owned businesses in energy, distribution, and government contracting. A proud Jemez
Pueblo tribal member, he leads company strategy and customer development with a long-term focus on
service and reliability.

Start the Relationship

## Ready to work together?

Reach out to Tribal Innovations to discuss your procurement environment, supply needs, or the kind
of relationship you want to build.

[Request a quote][11]

# Advanced Cancer *Treatment*

"CancerFax connects patients with complex, advanced, or relapsed cancers to expert second opinions,
cell and gene therapies, and clinical trials across China, India, Israel, Singapore, and the USA
through honest, clinically literate, patient-first navigation."

[Start your case review][27][Read patient stories][28]

Breast & Thyroid Cancer - 18 months in remission

Hi, I see you found us. If you're scared, I was too. A year ago I was Stage IV and had no options at
home. CancerFax found me a trial 4,000 miles away. You're not alone in this. Connect with me :-).

Patient Pathways

## How Can We Help You Today?

Choose where you are in your cancer journey and we'll guide you to the right resources and next
steps.

[

### Explore Advanced Treatments

CAR-T, TIL therapy, gene therapy, immunotherapy and more — understand what's available for your
diagnosis.

][29][

### Find Cancer-Specific Options

Search treatment and trial options tailored to your specific cancer type, stage, and molecular
profile.

][30][

### Get a Second Opinion

Access specialist review of your diagnosis, imaging, pathology, and current treatment plan from
expert oncologists.

][31][

### Search Clinical Trials

Explore investigational therapies and clinical trial opportunities that may be appropriate for your
condition.

][32][

### Compare Hospitals & Doctors

Understand your options across leading cancer centres, specialist expertise, and international
treatment destinations.

][33][

### Plan Treatment Abroad

End-to-end support for international care: visa guidance, medical coordination, travel assistance,
and more.

][34]
Advanced Cancer Treatment Navigation

## What does CancerFax do?

"Advanced cancer treatment guidance, clinical trial matching, and care coordination are three
pillars that take cancer patients from uncertainty to clarity."

### Comprehensive Medical Record Review

We carefully review your pathology reports, imaging scans, molecular test results, previous
treatments, and current clinical condition to understand your case as a whole. This comprehensive
assessment provides the foundation for identifying suitable treatment options and determining the
most appropriate next steps.

### Expert Second Opinion

We connect your case with experienced oncologists and multidisciplinary specialists for an
independent medical opinion. The second-opinion process can help confirm the diagnosis, review the
current treatment plan, identify overlooked options, and provide greater confidence before an
important treatment decision is made.

### Personalized Treatment Guidance

We help you understand which advanced treatment options may be relevant to your diagnosis, disease
stage, previous treatments, and molecular markers. These may include CAR T-cell therapy, TIL
therapy, gene therapy, immunotherapy, targeted therapy, proton therapy, and other emerging
treatments. We translate complex medical information into clear and actionable guidance.

### Specialist and Hospital Navigation

CancerFax helps match patients with appropriate specialists, hospitals, and cancer centers based on
their specific medical needs. We evaluate clinical expertise, treatment availability, institutional
capabilities, expected timelines, and other practical considerations so patients can make informed
decisions about where to seek treatment.

### Clinical Trial Matching and Access

We identify relevant clinical trials for patients with advanced, relapsed, rare, or
difficult-to-treat cancers, and we have particular expertise in accessing trials in China, India, [[CancerFax logo][CancerFax logo]][1]

## What does CancerFax do?

"Advanced cancer treatment guidance, clinical trial matching, and care coordination are three
pillars that take cancer patients from uncertainty to clarity."

### Comprehensive Medical Record Review

We carefully review your pathology reports, imaging scans, molecular test results, previous
treatments, and current clinical condition to understand your case as a whole. This comprehensive
assessment provides the foundation for identifying suitable treatment options and determining the
most appropriate next steps.

### Expert Second Opinion

We connect your case with experienced oncologists and multidisciplinary specialists for an
independent medical opinion. The second-opinion process can help confirm the diagnosis, review the
current treatment plan, identify overlooked options, and provide greater confidence before an
important treatment decision is made.

### Personalized Treatment Guidance

We help you understand which advanced treatment options may be relevant to your diagnosis, disease
stage, previous treatments, and molecular markers. These may include CAR T-cell therapy, TIL
therapy, gene therapy, immunotherapy, targeted therapy, proton therapy, and other emerging
treatments. We translate complex medical information into clear and actionable guidance.

### Specialist and Hospital Navigation

CancerFax helps match patients with appropriate specialists, hospitals, and cancer centers based on
their specific medical needs. We evaluate clinical expertise, treatment availability, institutional
capabilities, expected timelines, and other practical considerations so patients can make informed
decisions about where to seek treatment.

### Clinical Trial Matching and Access

We identify relevant clinical trials for patients with advanced, relapsed, rare, or
difficult-to-treat cancers, and we have particular expertise in accessing trials in China, India,
and the USA. Our team conducts an initial eligibility review, communicates with trial centers, and
guides patients through screening, documentation, and enrollment.

### End-to-End Care Coordination

From preparing medical documents and communicating with hospitals to appointment scheduling, visa
assistance, travel planning, admission support, and continuity of care, CancerFax coordinates the
complete treatment journey. This allows patients and their families to focus on treatment while we
manage the clinical and logistical details.

## Building the Future of Cancer Care

Our patient-centered approach is grounded in a singular focus — cancer care. That focus has driven
us throughout our history, and it has resulted in plans for a new dedicated inpatient cancer
hospital, and a transformative clinical collaboration.

[ Our Vision for Cancer Care ][133]

## Discover the Dana-Farber Difference

[physician-and-patient-stethoscope-600x368.webp]
[

Exceptional Clinical Care

][134]

At Dana-Farber, world-renowned specialists provide personalized cancer care informed by the latest
advances in treatment. From diagnosis through survivorship, we partner with patients and families to
deliver exceptional care and support every step of the way.

[researcher-writing-on-glass556x381.jpg]
[

Groundbreaking Research

][135]

Dana-Farber Cancer Institute remains true to Dr. Sidney Farber's vision of a cancer center that is
as dedicated to discoveries in cancer research as it is to delivering compassionate,
patient-centered care. Discoveries made by Dana-Farber researchers today become tomorrow’s
breakthrough treatments.

# Powerful
# & Precise Radiation.

[learn more ][37]

Cancer Treatment That Prioritizes
Your Quality of Life

## How Proton Therapy Works

Proton therapy is an extremely precise form of radiation treatment.

It uses positively charged particles to deliver radiation that matches the size, shape, and depth of
a tumor down to the millimeter. Unlike traditional radiation, protons stop at the tumor, reducing
exposure to surrounding healthy tissue. This may lower the risk of side effects and help patients
return to life sooner.

[ Learn More ][38]

## Advanced Proton Therapy Technology

Emory Proton Therapy Center uses pencil beam scanning, the most advanced form of proton therapy
available in Georgia. This technique “paints” the tumor with radiation spot by spot, making it ideal

## How Proton Therapy Works

Proton therapy is an extremely precise form of radiation treatment.

It uses positively charged particles to deliver radiation that matches the size, shape, and depth of
a tumor down to the millimeter. Unlike traditional radiation, protons stop at the tumor, reducing
exposure to surrounding healthy tissue. This may lower the risk of side effects and help patients
return to life sooner.

[ Learn More ][38]

## Advanced Proton Therapy Technology

Emory Proton Therapy Center uses pencil beam scanning, the most advanced form of proton therapy
available in Georgia. This technique “paints” the tumor with radiation spot by spot, making it ideal
for irregular shapes or tumors near sensitive areas. Every treatment room features leading-edge
imaging, including MRI and cone-beam CT, for precise tumor targeting and monitoring.

[ Learn More ][39]

## About

### ESMO Open

[[Cover Image - ESMO Open, Volume 11, Issue 7]][78]

*ESMO Open* is the European Society for Medical Oncology's online-only, peer-reviewed open access
journal, dedicated to publishing high-quality medical research and educational content from all
disciplines of oncology, with a focus on innovative clinical and translational cancer research. The
Journal aims to maximize industry networks to curate and disseminate preclinical or translational
data. We hope to bridge the gap between basic research and clinical applications, facilitating the
translation of groundbreaking discoveries into tangible advancements in cancer care. Our platform
will serve as a catalyst for innovation, nurturing the dialogue between academia, industry, and
clinical practice.

### ESMO

[ESMO  Opens in new window][79]   is the European Society for Medical Oncology. Representing over
50,000 members globally, ESMO is a reference for oncology education and information.

Founded in 1975, ESMO has European roots with a global reach. Home for all oncology stakeholders,
ESMO connects professionals with diverse expertise and experience. Its education and information
resources support an integrated multi-professional approach to cancer care, from a medical oncology
perspective.

ESMO seeks to erase boundaries in cancer care, whether between countries or specialities, and pursue
its mission

## What is **Proton Therapy**?

an effective cancer treatment alternative

Less risk. Higher quality of life during treatment.

Proton therapy for cancer is an advanced form of radiation that uses protons, rather than X-rays.
Protons can be precisely controlled, allowing our physicians to closely target your tumor and
deliver powerful doses of radiation with:
* Less damage to healthy tissue
* Fewer side effects
* Low risk of secondary cancers
* Better quality of life during and after treatment

# See what your competitors

While others chase press releases and earnings calls, we capture real intelligence from the data
trails companies leave behind unknowingly — whether competitors, acquisition targets, potential
partners, or emerging disruptors.

## Trusted by teams at

[Intuit][S2A][Eleventh Hour Group][Abridge]
The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

How it works

Each step compresses the input. Thousands of raw signals collapse into a handful of patterns, then
into a single forecast you can act on.

## Non-Toxic Therapies That Target Cancer Cells

Patient-Centered Integrative & Alternative Cancer Treatment Center

Take the first step toward integrative cancer care. Contact Hope4Cancer to schedule a complimentary
consultation and receive a personalized treatment plan tailored to individual diagnosis and goals.

Play Video [Dr. Tony Jimenez speaking with a doctor at Hope4Cancer] Your browser does not support
the video tag.

Hope4Cancer Treatment Centers provide personalized, non-toxic alternative cancer treatment at two
world-class facilities in Cancun and Playas de Tijuana, Mexico. Since 2000, the board-certified
medical team led by founder Antonio Jimenez, M.D., N.D., has treated thousands of patients from over
100 countries, offering more integrative cancer therapies under one roof than any other center in
the world.

Integrative Cancer Treatment Rooted in the 7 Key Principles

Every treatment program at Hope4Cancer follows the 7 Key Principles of Cancer Therapy, a
comprehensive clinical framework that addresses cancer from multiple angles simultaneously. Rather
than focusing solely on the tumor, this approach treats the whole person, targeting cancer cells
with non-toxic therapies while simultaneously restoring immune function, optimizing nutrition,
supporting detoxification, rebalancing the microbiome, providing oxygenation therapy, and addressing
emotional and spiritual well-being.

Non-Toxic Therapies That Target Cancer Cells

The Hope4Cancer protocol includes Sono-Photo Dynamic Therapy (SPDT), Photo Dynamic Therapy Plus
using advanced laser technology, bio-immunotherapy, hyperthermia, pulsed electromagnetic field
therapy (PEMF), ozone therapy, IV nutrient infusions, and many additional modalities. Each therapy
is selected for its ability to selectively target malignant cells while leaving healthy tissue
unharmed, avoiding the debilitating side effects commonly associated with conventional chemotherapy
and radiation.

Immune System Restoration and Support

The proprietary Sunivera Bio-Immunotherapy Protocol combines a macrophage activating factor (MAF)
with synergistic nutraceuticals to modulate both innate and adaptive immune responses. This
protocol, developed from 25 years of research at leading institutions, helps restore the immune
system's natural cancer-fighting capabilities, which are often compromised by the disease itself or
by prior conventional treatments.

World-Class Cancer Treatment Centers

Hope4Cancer operates two strategically located treatment centers on the Pacific and Caribbean coasts
of Mexico. Both facilities provide access to cutting-edge therapies and technologies in
healing-focused environments.

# Pioneering a Transformational Approach to Treating Cancer

Iovance Biotherapeutics is pioneering a transformational approach to treating cancer by harnessing
the ability of the human immune system to recognize and attack diverse cancer cells in each patient.

[About Iovance Biotherapeutics][41]

## TIL therapy

Tumor infiltrating lymphocytes (TIL) are naturally occurring immune cells that fight cancer. TIL are
on constant surveillance to recognize, attack and kill cancer cells. When cancer invades and
prevails, the TIL are unable to perform their intended function. Investigational TIL therapies are
designed to reinvigorate a patient’s TIL to fight cancer. A patient’s naturally occurring TIL are
collected and grown outside the body so they can be administered back to the patient as a one-time
treatment. Once inside the body, **Iovance TIL therapy deploys billions of personalized,
patient-specific TIL to recognize and target diverse cancer cells.**

TIL monotherapy and TIL combination therapies are being investigated in clinical studies in multiple
advanced solid tumor cancers.

 

[Learn more about TIL therapy][42]

[View our scientific publications & presentations][43]

## Now Enrolling

[ Advanced Front-line Melanoma (TILVANCE-301) ][44] [ Advanced Second-line NSCLC (IOV-LUN-202) ][45]
[ Advanced Endometrial Cancer (IOV-END-201) ][46]

## Latest news

[ View All News Releases ][47]

## Clinical platforms

Our T-cell-based immunotherapy technology platforms are potentially applicable to many solid tumor
types. Each platform is focused on leveraging patient-specific cells to recognize and attack diverse
cancer cells that are unique to each patient. Unlike targeted cell therapies that act on shared
antigen targets common to certain tumors, our polyclonal T cells are personalized therapies designed
to target a variety of neoantigens (new proteins generated by tumor mutations) that are unique to
the patient or tumor.

We are currently investigating TIL therapy in clinical trials in multiple advanced solid tumor
cancers. We are also advancing genetically modified TIL therapies as a next-generation approach for
solid tumor cancers.

[View our clinical pipeline][48]

## Iovance Cell Therapy Center (*i*CTC)

Our TIL therapy is manufactured at our state-of-the-art, 136,000–square-foot Cell Therapy Center,
located in Philadelphia, PA, using proprietary good manufacturing practices (GMP).

[Learn more about the *i*CTC][49]

  graduate medical education programs in the country.

  The Center is an applied research, usability, safety advisement, and education center. We are
  committed to the scientific study of how humans think, work, and interact with the healthcare
  environment.
  
  The Center is the largest program of its kind embedded within a healthcare system in the U.S.

# Proton beam therapy protects what matters. *Understand the difference.*

[ Learn more ][74]

At Proton International London, the UK’s only private proton beam therapy service, we deliver
precise, protective, and powerful cancer treatment.

## What is proton beam therapy?

Proton beam therapy is an advanced type of radiotherapy that uses highly charged particles to
deliver radiation to cancer cells, to stop them growing and spreading.

[Learn more][75]

## What are the benefits?

Proton beam therapy targets tumours with greater precision than traditional radiotherapy, reducing
the risk of short and long-term side effects.

[Read about the benefits][76]

## What can I expect?

Proton beam therapy treatment sessions usually take around an hour, five days a week, for several
weeks. It is delivered via a specialist proton beam machine from outside the body and is painless.

[What to expect][77]

## Who is it for?

Proton beam therapy is suitable for treating cancer where precision is vital to avoid damage to
healthy cells, such as in children and adults with brain, spinal, and prostate cancer (among
others).

[Am I suitable for proton beam therapy?][78]

## Welcome to the UK’s only private proton beam therapy centre

At Proton International London, we offer an advanced form of radiotherapy known as proton beam
therapy (PBT).

Treatment is available to private patients from the UK and worldwide at our treatment centre in the
esteemed University College Hospital in London, in partnership with University College London
Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust (UCLH).

If you are here, then perhaps you are researching cancer treatment for yourself or a loved one.
Firstly, we understand how overwhelming this can feel, and we’re here to offer clarity and
reassurance. Our website is designed to give you all of the information you need about proton beam
therapy to help you make informed decisions and take your next step with confidence.

## What is proton beam therapy?

Proton beam therapy (PBT) is an advanced form of radiotherapy used to treat cancer (see the types of
cancer we treat below). Unlike conventional radiotherapy, it delivers a more powerful and precise
dose to the tumour, reducing damage to surrounding healthy tissue. This can lower the risk of side
effects and, in turn, improve quality of life. This is particularly helpful in treating children,
whose bodies are still developing, or in adults, where vital organs are at risk from long-term side
effects.

## FAQs

**How can social networking benefit physicians?**

As a physician, being up-to-date on today’s medical news is essential; but remaining on the
cutting-edge of the medical world is not easy. A social network for doctors like Sermo can help
empower physicians across [medical specialties][46] to achieve their personal and professional
goals, while having fun and making meaningful connections with others.

Sermo is the only dedicated social network for doctors in the world—bringing together more than
1,000,000 triple-verified physicians, who are looking for and sharing the latest medical insights.
By joining Sermo, you can improve your medical practice and grow your professional network.

Sermo gives you access to the latest medical news so you can read, collaborate, and discuss with
your fellow professionals. The easy-to-use platform provides access to exclusive content, while
helping you keep a pulse on the latest happenings in the medical world.

The popularity of social media by physicians had been steadily and consistently growing; but in
2020—as COVID-19 completely changed the way the world communicated—the number of physicians engaging
in social media grew exponentially. Sermo experienced an 83% increase in global unique logins on its
platform alone—and a 24% increase in time spent on the site.

When physicians were asked to compare physician-only social platforms against general social media,
they said physician-only platforms offered more credibility, security, privacy, value of
information, and allowed a better connectivity with peers.

*“Sermo is an excellent tool for connecting colleagues and often helps us share our experiences and
clarify diagnostic and therapeutic doubts.”* —Sermo Member, Orthopedic Surgeon

The top 3 reasons physicians use social media professionally across all markets are:

1. Staying up to date on medical news.
2. Connecting with peers.
3. Sharing knowledge.

At Texas Oncology, we're committed to making your cancer care experience as supportive and
empowering as possible.


Our team of compassionate, highly trained oncologists provides comprehensive treatment options
tailored to your individual needs. Whether you're undergoing chemotherapy, radiation, or other
therapies, we’re here to guide you with expertise, respect, and care — every step of the way.

‌

[[Texas Oncology banner image featuring a smiling older male patient holding a cane while a
healthcare provider in blue scrubs places a reassuring hand on his shoulder, conveying compassionate
patient care, with a blue overlay on the left side of the image]][11]
[About Texas Oncology][12]

Texas Oncology’s mission is to provide evidence-based and high-quality care to each patient we
serve, while advancing cancer care for tomorrow.

‌

[[Texas Oncology banner image featuring a smiling young female cancer patient seated across from her
physician at a consultation table, with a clipboard nearby, conveying compassionate and personalized
cancer care, with a blue overlay on the left side of the image]][13]
[Cancer Care][14]

Texas Oncology helps patients navigate their cancer journeys with a highly-skilled care team
featuring physicians, advanced practice providers, pharmacists, and social workers.

‌

[[Texas Oncology banner image featuring a focused female researcher in a white lab coat, safety
goggles, and stethoscope working in a laboratory setting, with a deep blue overlay on the left side
of the image]][15]
[Clinical Trials][16]

Texas Oncology is a leader in groundbreaking cancer research and clinical trials in Texas, paving
the way for new breakthroughs in cancer care.

## Our Specialty Programs

Specialty

### [Medical Oncology][17]

Our medical oncology team specializes in diagnosis, personalized treatment planning, and coordinated
care to support you every step of the way.
Specialty

### [Radiation Oncology][18]

Targeted radiation therapy tailored to your goals for effective, precise cancer care.
Specialty

### [Hematology][19]

Comprehensive care for blood cancers and disorders—anemia, leukemia, and clotting—personalized
treatment close to home.
Specialty

### [Breast Care][20]

Texas Breast Specialists is a group of physicians dedicated to diagnosing and treating diseases and
disorders of the breast – both cancerous and benign.
Specialty

### [Colorectal Care][21]

The surgeons of Texas Colon & Rectal Specialists offer advanced screening, diagnosis, and treatment
for colon and rectal conditions, improving health and quality of life.
Specialty

### [Urology][22]

The physicians of Texas Urology Specialists offer compassionate and comprehensive urology care and
advanced treatments for a wide range of urologic conditions.
Specialty

### [Surgical Oncology][23]

Texas Oncology Surgical Specialists offers comprehensive cancer surgery—biopsies, tumor removal, and
minimally invasive options from skilled surgical oncologists.
Specialty

### [Gynecologic Oncology][24]

Compassionate, advanced surgery and care for ovarian, uterine, cervical, and vulvar cancers.
Specialty

### [Proton Therapy][25]

Targeted proton therapy delivers powerful cancer treatment with fewer side effects—close to home at
Texas Oncology.
[Exterior of a Texas Oncology clinic location at 9750 Hillwood Parkway, featuring a modern building

the stone facade, surrounded by native ornamental grasses under a partly cloudy sky]
We make it as easy as possible to access the care you need. With more than 250 locations, you are
likely to find a provider near where you live and work.

# Dependable medical supply support for Indian health organizations.

Tribal Innovations is a Native-owned medical-supply distributor helping Indian Health Service
facilities, tribal healthcare programs, and urban Indian health organizations access the products
they need with responsive, relationship-first service.

[Request a quote][8][View product categories][9]

Why Tribal Innovations

## Native ownership, workflow capability, and fulfillment depth — together

Tribal Innovations combines Native-owned positioning with the operational capability and supply
depth to actually deliver — making us a more credible partner for Indian health organizations.

### Native-owned and procurement-aligned

Built to serve Indian Health Service facilities, tribally operated healthcare programs, and urban
Indian health organizations through a Native-owned business model.

### Workflow capability that supports execution

Tribal’s model is designed to help manage invoicing, account coordination, and the practical steps
required to move orders forward.

### Supply depth through a national partner

The company’s operating model combines community alignment with broader fulfillment infrastructure,
helping reduce the gap between access and reliable delivery.

Who We Serve

## Supporting the organizations at the heart of Indian health procurement

### Indian Health Service facilities

Reliable medical-supply support for Indian health operations.

### Tribally operated healthcare programs

Responsive service built for the way tribal healthcare programs work.

### Urban Indian health organizations

Dependable product access through a Native-owned partner.

[Cardinal Health — authorized distributor partner of Tribal Innovations]

Supply Partnership

## Authorized distributor partner of Cardinal Health

A recurring challenge in this market is vendors who win contracts but lack the supply depth to
fulfill reliably. Tribal Innovations addresses this directly: as an authorized Cardinal Health
distributor, customers get access to Cardinal's full product catalog and fulfillment infrastructure
— through a Native-owned partner.

Access to Cardinal Health's full medical-supply catalog

Reliable fulfillment through an established national supply network

Native-owned positioning without sacrificing product depth or reliability

What We Bring

## Built to deliver, not just to win the contract

Indian health procurement rewards vendors who show up reliably over time. Tribal Innovations is
built around the capabilities that make that possible.

Authorized Cardinal Health distributor — access to a broad national catalog, not a thin sourcing
list.

Native-owned positioning aligned with Indian health procurement pathways and preference programs.

Invoicing and billing support designed for Indian health settings, including coordination with
government payment workflows.

Direct, responsive account management — a real relationship, not a ticketing system.

A fulfillment model built for reliability, so the order that gets placed is the order that arrives.

Family Leadership

## Rooted in Jemez Pueblo, built for the long term

Tribal Innovations is led by a family with deep community roots in Jemez Pueblo and a clear
commitment to service, trust, and long-term follow-through.

[Meet the leadership team][10]
[Allen Gachupin]

### Allen Gachupin

President

Allen Gachupin founded Tribal Innovations and serves as President, leading the company with a
philosophy grounded in service, character, and accountability. A proud Jemez Pueblo tribal member
and U.S. Army veteran, he has dedicated his career to community leadership and building lasting
relationships.

[Kai Gachupin]

### Kai Gachupin

CEO

Kai Gachupin serves as CEO of Tribal Innovations, bringing more than two decades of experience
leading Native-owned businesses in energy, distribution, and government contracting. A proud Jemez
Pueblo tribal member, he leads company strategy and customer development with a long-term focus on
service and reliability.

Start the Relationship

## Ready to work together?

Reach out to Tribal Innovations to discuss your procurement environment, supply needs, or the kind
of relationship you want to build.

[Request a quote][11]
